description: This Kotlin source file defines the AuthActivity class that manages user authentication using Firebase Authentication with Google Sign-In. It initiates the sign-in flow with Google's One Tap sign-in, handles the sign-in result, authenticates with Firebase, and redirects authenticated users to the MainActivity.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages user authentication using Firebase Auth integrated with Google Sign-In, including initiating the sign-in flow, handling the result, and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: startAuthFlow
methods.description: Starts the Google sign-in flow by building the sign-in request and launching the intent sender.

methods.name: buildIntentSenderRequest
methods.description: Helper method that creates an IntentSenderRequest from an IntentSender for launching the sign-in flow.
